scope.supports: Kernel-checked for arbitrary types PD, S, with Real0 PD S given the two-constructor shape of OntologyBasic.Real0: both injections are injective, their ranges are disjoint and exhaustive, Real0 is equivalent to PD + S, every pair of maps out of the channels has exactly one extension (universal property), and the number of maps out of the coproduct is the product of the numbers of maps out of the channels (|C|^(|PD|+|S|)). A map out of the coproduct that is the identity on one channel (a retraction onto it) exists iff that channel is nonempty or the other channel is empty: a retraction onto the difference channel is impossible only when that channel is empty and the structure channel is not (and symmetrically); whenever both channels are inhabited retractions in both directions exist (retractions_both_ways_of_nonempty), each one of |A|^|B| choices that the coproduct does not select. So bare function-existence is trivial for inhabited channels and does NOT formalise "no reduction of either channel to the other". Real0 is nonempty iff a channel is, empty for two empty channels, and all four combinations of the two nonemptiness posits are realised, so neither posit follows from the construction or from the other. Native exhaustive tables: 38 map counts (|A|,|B| <= 2 with |C| <= 3, plus (3,2,2) and (2,3,2)), 16 retraction tables for |A|,|B| <= 3, and the four-row posit table; the injection, disjointness and covering columns are set facts built from the tags, so the kernel theorems are the evidence for them.
scope.does_not_support: Anything about the actual OntologyBasic.Real0 beyond its constructor shape (the file is not imported; its payloads are universe-polymorphic record types). The real Real0 has the record TYPES PrimitiveDifference and Structure as channels; both are inhabited, so by retracts_to_pd_iff and retracts_to_s_iff retractions in both directions exist for it: the emptiness cases of this file are not instances of the real node, and nothing here says either channel is irreducible to the other. That either channel exists, is real or has an origin (admitted posits, ENC-1138 lineage withdrawn); the passage from the literal inscription (PG-INERT-DIAMOND, route marked GAP_NO_DERIVATION); the clauses "carrier-Structure precedes a primitive difference", "residual-Structure Q^1 = C^1/im d0 is what the difference produces" and "the ladder is a definability order"; any physical or interpretive reading.
scope.narrowest_claim: The typed coproduct of two payload types (same two-constructor shape as OntologyBasic.Real0) is a categorical coproduct that supplies no map between the channels and no element of either channel: a map out of it that is the identity on one channel exists exactly when that channel is nonempty or the other is empty (so bare existence of such a map is not a reduction theorem for inhabited channels), and the two nonemptiness conditions are independent of the construction and of each other.
scope.next_test: Formalise the clause "carrier-Structure precedes a primitive difference": define precedence as the statement that a PrimitiveDifference record can be built with no Structure value in scope (Source := PUnit) and a Structure record with no PrimitiveDifference, then decide whether Source must equal Structure.Carrier for the node text to be meant, by a finite model or a counterexample.
